Thank You for the peace that comes from knowing I am held by Your mighty hand. I honor You for Your faithfulness and Your goodness. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-15.versiculo: Revelation 1:17-18 KJV: "And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death."
2028-07-15.reflexion:
The touch of the Savior is the ultimate source of peace. In this powerful vision, John experiences the overwhelming majesty of the glorified Christ, and in his humility, he falls. Immediately, the Lord responds with a gesture of profound tenderness, placing His right hand upon him. This touch is an invitation to courage and a reminder of our belonging in Him. Jesus declares His eternal nature, identifying Himself as the First and the Last. He is the beginning of all things and the completion of every promise. He exists beyond the constraints of time, holding our past, present, and future in His sovereign care.

The victory of the Resurrection is the cornerstone of our hope. Christ speaks of His journey through death into an eternal, living reality. He is alive forevermore, and this life is the light that illuminates our darkest valleys. By holding the keys of hell and death, Jesus asserts His absolute authority over every power that seeks to separate us from God. He possesses the power to unlock the gates of eternity and lead His children into a place of everlasting joy. We can rest in the assurance that the One who leads us has already overcome the greatest enemy. Every step we take is guided by the One who possesses all authority in heaven and on earth. His presence is our sanctuary, and His victory is our inheritance. We are held by the hand of the Eternal King, who transforms our fragility into strength and our mourning into a song of praise.

para_meditar.texto: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

2028-07-15.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude for the victory of Your Son. We praise You for the glorious truth that Jesus Christ is the First and the Last, the Alpha and the Omega of our lives. We thank You for the comfort of His right hand, which reaches out to us in our moments of weakness and restores our spirits. Lord, we celebrate the triumph of the Resurrection. We rejoice that Jesus is alive forevermore and that He holds the keys to eternity. We place our trust in His absolute authority and find our peace in His eternal presence. May Your Holy Spirit fill us with a courage that comes from knowing we are loved by the King of Kings. Guide our steps today in the light of Your truth. Help us to walk with confidence, knowing that death has been defeated and that our future is secure in Your hands. We surrender our worries to Your sovereign care and lift our voices in praise to the One who has conquered all things. We love You and honor You in the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-16.versiculo: Revelation 2:10 KJV: "Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life."
2028-07-16.reflexion: The promise of eternal life is a steady anchor for the soul during the most turbulent seasons of our journey. In the words of Revelation 2:10, we find a divine assurance that our endurance is seen and valued by the Creator. Every challenge we face serves as a refining fire, shaping our character and strengthening our reliance on the grace of God. The mention of a specific duration, such as ten days, reminds us that every trial has a definite end. God holds the calendar of our lives, and He determines the moment of our deliverance. Faithfulness is a daily choice to trust in the goodness of Christ, regardless of the circumstances surrounding us. This steadfast devotion is the path to the crown of life, a reward that transcends all earthly suffering. We walk forward with confidence, knowing that our Savior has already overcome the world. His presence is our constant companion in the prison of hardship or the valley of shadow. We find our strength in His victory, resting in the truth that our loyalty to Him brings a joy that lasts forever. The crown of life is a testament to a heart that remained true to its King until the very end. We are called to a high standard of loyalty, and we are empowered by a love that is stronger than death itself.

para_meditar.texto: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

2028-07-16.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You with a heart that seeks Your strength and Your peace. I thank You for the promise of the crown of life and for the assurance that You are with me in every trial. Please grant me a spirit of courage and a heart of steadfast faithfulness. Fill me with the Holy Spirit so that I may stand firm in my faith, even when the path is difficult. I trust in Your perfect timing and Your sovereign plan for my life. Help me to keep my eyes fixed on the eternal reward, remembering that the joys of heaven far exceed any earthly struggle. I surrender my fears to Your loving care and embrace the victory that is found in Your Son. May my life be a reflection of Your grace and a testimony of Your enduring love. Strengthen my resolve to remain loyal to You in every season, knowing that You are my shield and my great reward. I praise You for Your faithfulness and Your unending mercy. I trust You completely with my future and my present. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-17.versiculo: Colossians 3:9 KJV: "Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;"
2028-07-17.reflexion: The beauty of the Christian life is found in the wonderful transformation God works within us. When we come to faith in Christ, we receive a completely new identity. This new nature is a gift of grace that allows us to walk in a way that honors God. The apostle Paul reminds us that we have put off the old self, leaving behind the habits and behaviors that belonged to a life apart from God. Now, we are clothed in the righteousness of Christ, and this new clothing manifests in every area of our lives, including our speech. Truth is the very essence of God. He is the Way, the Truth, and the Life. Therefore, as we grow in our relationship with Him, our words begin to mirror His heart. Speaking the truth to one another is a powerful testimony of the Spirit's work in our souls. Honesty creates a safe harbor for community, fostering deep trust and genuine love among believers. When we choose truth, we align ourselves with the light of God's kingdom. Living in truth is an act of worship. It shows that we trust God to handle our situations and that we rely on His strength rather than our own cleverness. Every honest word is a seed planted in the soil of the Kingdom, bringing peace and clarity to those around us. We are called to be people of integrity, where our inner reality and outer expression are in harmony. This harmony is a result of the Holy Spirit dwelling within us, refining our character and guiding our tongues. Let us embrace this new life with joy, knowing that we are created for holiness and designed to reflect the purity of our Savior in everything we say.

para_meditar.texto: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

2028-07-17.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You with a heart full of gratitude for the new life You have given me through Your Son, Jesus Christ. I thank You for the grace that has transformed my identity and for the strength You provide to walk in Your ways. I praise You for being the source of all truth and light. I ask that Your Holy Spirit would dwell richly in my heart, guiding every word that leaves my lips. Help me to be a person of unwavering integrity and honesty in all my dealings with others. May my speech be seasoned with grace and rooted in the truth of Your Word. I pray that my life would be a reflection of Your purity and holiness, bringing glory to Your name in every conversation. Grant me the courage to be transparent and the wisdom to speak words that build up and encourage my brothers and sisters in faith. I surrender my tongue and my heart to Your lordship, trusting that You are perfecting the work You started in me. I desire to live in the light, walking in the freedom that comes from a heart aligned with Your will. I commit my ways to You, seeking to honor You through a life of honesty and love. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-18.versiculo: Revelation 4:11 KJV: "Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created."
2028-07-18.reflexion: The vision in the book of Revelation opens a window into the eternal reality of heaven, where the atmosphere is saturated with the worship of the Creator. When we read that the Lord is worthy to receive glory, honor, and power, we are reminded of the fundamental truth of our existence. God is the sovereign Architect of all that exists. His wisdom is evident in the vastness of the galaxies and the intricate detail of a single flower. Every element of nature is a brushstroke of His creativity, designed specifically for His delight. We are a part of this grand design. Our lives are a testimony to His love and His intentionality. The worship seen in the heavenly throne room is the natural and right response to the truth of who He is. He is the source of all life, the sustainer of all breath, and the goal of all longing. We find our deepest peace and highest purpose when we align our hearts with the truth that we were created for His pleasure. This means our lives have a divine destination and a holy meaning. Every moment we spend in gratitude is a moment we enter into the rhythm of heaven. His power sustains us, His honor guides us, and His glory illuminates our path. We are invited to join the eternal chorus in acknowledging His absolute worthiness, finding our joy in the simple fact that we belong to Him.

para_meditar.texto: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

2028-07-18.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude and awe. You are the King of kings and the Lord of lords. We acknowledge Your supreme authority over every corner of the universe. We thank You for the breath in our lungs and the beauty of the world You have fashioned. You are the source of all light and truth. We offer You our lives as a living sacrifice of praise. May our thoughts, words, and actions bring a smile to Your face. We desire to live in a way that reflects Your holiness and love. We surrender our wills to Your perfect plan, knowing that Your pleasure is our highest calling. Fill us with Your Holy Spirit so that we may walk in Your ways and honor Your name in all we do. We celebrate Your power that holds all things together and Your grace that welcomes us into Your presence. We lift Your name high above all other names, for You alone are worthy of all glory and honor. We trust in Your goodness and find our rest in Your eternal love, in the name of Jesus, amen.

2028-07-19.versiculo: Revelation 5:12 KJV: "Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing."
2028-07-19.reflexion: The vision of Revelation opens our eyes to the magnificent reality of heaven, where the atmosphere is filled with an unending song of praise. At the center of this celestial worship is the Lamb, the one who gave His life for the redemption of all. There is a profound beauty in the truth that the very sacrifice of the cross is what makes Jesus most worthy of all honor. His humility in death became the foundation of His ultimate victory. When we read that He is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing, we are reminded that everything in existence belongs to Him. He is the architect of our salvation and the sustainer of our souls. His wisdom guides us through the darkest valleys, and His strength carries us when our own energy fails. To acknowledge His worthiness is to place our lives in the hands of the one who loves us perfectly. We can rest in the certainty that the Lamb who was slain is now the King who reigns. Every joy we experience is a reflection of His goodness. Every victory we achieve is a result of His grace. By focusing our hearts on His majesty, we find a peace that surpasses understanding. We join the heavenly host in declaring that He alone is the center of our affection and the goal of our journey. His glory fills the universe, and His love fills our hearts to overflowing.

para_meditar.texto: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

2028-07-19.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude. We lift our voices to join the song of heaven, declaring that the Lamb is worthy. We thank You for the sacrifice of Your Son, whose love has brought us home. We acknowledge that all power and riches belong to Him. We lean on His infinite wisdom to guide our steps and His unmatched strength to support us in every season. Lord, we surrender our lives to Your will, recognizing that Your glory is the highest purpose of our existence. Fill us with a spirit of worship that carries over into every moment of our day. May our actions reflect the honor due to the King of kings. We celebrate the blessing that flows from His throne into our lives. We trust in His sovereign rule and find comfort in His eternal presence. We praise You for the victory won at the cross and the hope we have in the resurrection. We love You and adore You, forever and always, in the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-20.versiculo: Colossians 3:12 KJV: "Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;"
2028-07-20.reflexion: You are a precious child of God. You are chosen, holy, and deeply loved. This divine identity is the starting point for everything you do and the foundation upon which your life is built. Paul encourages us to dress ourselves in a new way, treating the virtues of the Spirit like a garment we choose to wear each morning. Mercy is the warmth of a heart that beats with compassion for others. Kindness is the gentle expression of God's love manifested in our daily words and actions. Humility is a quiet confidence in God's sovereignty, allowing us to see others as significant and valued. Meekness is a beautiful strength, a controlled power that chooses peace and gentleness in every situation. Longsuffering is the steady endurance of love, remaining constant and faithful even when the road is long. These virtues are the outward signs of an inward transformation. When we walk in these truths, we reflect the image of Christ to the world. Our lives become a living testimony of the grace we have received. We are called to embody the very nature of our Savior, letting His light shine through our patience and our gentleness. Every interaction is an opportunity to wear the garment of love and to show the world the beauty of a life surrendered to the Lord.

para_meditar.texto: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.

They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat. For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

2028-07-20.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You with a heart full of gratitude for Your unending love. Thank You for calling me Your own and for marking me as holy and beloved in Your sight. I cherish the identity You have given me through Your grace. I ask for Your Holy Spirit to empower me today to put on the virtues of Christ. Fill my heart with a deep sense of mercy for everyone I encounter. Let Your kindness flow through my words and my deeds, bringing comfort to those in need. Grant me a spirit of true humility, that I may honor You and serve others with a joyful heart. I pray for a meek and gentle spirit, trusting in Your strength to lead me. Give me the grace of longsuffering, so that I may remain patient and steadfast in all circumstances. May my life be a reflection of Your goodness and a witness to Your transforming power. I surrender my will to Yours, desiring only to mirror the character of Your Son in every moment of my day. I trust in Your guidance and Your provision. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-21.versiculo: Revelation 12:11 KJV: "And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death."
2028-07-21.reflexion: The victory of the believer is a beautiful reality rooted in the finished work of Jesus Christ. When we look at the words of Revelation 12:11, we see a clear roadmap for triumph in a world filled with challenges. This victory begins with the blood of the Lamb. The sacrifice of Jesus is the ultimate foundation of our peace and our standing before God. His blood cleanses us, restores us, and grants us access to the Father. We stand secure because the price has been paid in full. This divine provision is the source of our strength and the reason we can face every trial with confidence. Alongside this foundation, we find power in the word of our testimony. Sharing what God has done in our lives is a powerful act of faith. When we speak the truth of His goodness and His faithfulness, we reinforce our own faith and encourage others. Our stories are living evidence of God's grace in action. Furthermore, the verse highlights a love for Christ that outweighs the desire for earthly comfort. This is a love that is fully committed and entirely surrendered. It is a devotion that finds its greatest joy in following the Savior, regardless of the cost. We are called to live lives of total surrender, trusting that the eternal rewards far exceed any temporary security. In this sacred union of the blood, the testimony, and a surrendered heart, we find a victory that is eternal and unshakable. We walk forward in the light of the cross, knowing that the Lamb has already won the battle.

para_meditar.texto: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

2028-07-21.oracion: Gracious Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude for the precious gift of Your Son. We thank You for the blood of the Lamb, which brings us complete redemption and eternal hope. We celebrate the victory that is ours through Jesus Christ, knowing that His sacrifice is sufficient for every need. Lord, we ask for a spirit of boldness to share our testimonies. May our words be a reflection of Your mercy and a beacon of light to those around us. Fill our mouths with Your truth and our hearts with Your love. We desire to love You with all our soul, mind, and strength. Grant us a heart of total surrender, where Your will is our greatest desire and Your glory is our highest goal. We trust in Your providence and lean on Your everlasting arms. We commit our lives entirely to Your service, finding our security and our joy in Your presence alone. We walk in the triumph of the cross today and every day. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-22.versiculo: Revelation 19:6-7 KJV: "And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth. Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready."
2028-07-22.reflexion:
Imagine the sound of a thousand waterfalls and the resonance of a mighty storm, all blending into one single, glorious song of praise. This is the atmosphere of heaven described in Revelation. It is a scene of absolute victory and overwhelming joy. The central truth ringing through the air is that the Lord God Omnipotent reigns. His authority is complete, His power is absolute, and His kingdom is eternal. When we reflect on this truth, our hearts find a steady anchor. We live in the certainty that the Creator of the universe holds every detail of history in His hands.

The celebration reaches its peak with the announcement of the marriage of the Lamb. This beautiful imagery represents the ultimate union between Christ and His people. It is the fulfillment of every promise and the completion of every longing. The bride has made herself ready, dressed in the righteousness provided by grace and shining with the light of holiness. This readiness is a reflection of a heart that loves the Savior and waits for Him with eager anticipation.

Our current journey is a preparation for this great day. We are called to live lives that reflect the beauty of the Groom. Every act of kindness, every moment of faith, and every word of truth adds to the radiance of the bride. We can walk through our daily challenges with a smile, knowing that the end of the story is a wedding feast of unimaginable splendor. Our hope is a living reality. We belong to the King, and we are moving toward a home where joy is the only language and love is the only law. The reign of God is our security, and the marriage of the Lamb is our eternal reward.

para_meditar.texto: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

2028-07-22.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude and awe. We praise You as the Omnipotent God who reigns over all creation. Your power is a comfort to us, and Your sovereignty is our peace. We thank You for the promise of the great marriage feast, where we shall be united with the Lamb forever. Help us to walk in holiness and purity as we prepare ourselves for that glorious day. May our lives be a reflection of Your love and grace, shining brightly in a world that needs Your light. We choose to rejoice in Your victory today. We lift our voices in Alleluia, acknowledging that You are the King of kings and the Lord of lords. Fill us with a holy longing for Your presence and a steadfast commitment to Your will. We trust in Your timing and we lean on Your strength. We are Your people, and we are honored to be the bride of Christ. We wait with joyful expectation for the moment we see Your face. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-23.versiculo: Revelation 21:1-2 KJV: "And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea. And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband."
2028-07-23.reflexion: Imagine a world where every breath is filled with the fragrance of paradise and every sight is a masterpiece of divine art. The Apostle John gives us a breathtaking glimpse into the ultimate destination of every believer: a new heaven and a new earth. This vision is a glorious promise of complete restoration and renewal. God is creating a place of absolute harmony, where the rhythms of existence align perfectly with His holy will. The New Jerusalem descends from heaven as a bride, shimmering with the radiance of her Husband. This imagery speaks of a deep, eternal love and a perfect union between the Creator and His children. We are invited to look forward to a home where everything is made right and every longing is satisfied. The presence of God fills every corner of this holy city, bringing a light that never fades and a warmth that sustains the soul. We can walk in confidence today, knowing that our future is secure in the hands of the One who makes all things new. This hope anchors our souls and gives us strength during our journey on earth. We are citizens of this heavenly city, destined for a life of eternal joy and divine fellowship. The beauty of the New Jerusalem reflects the purity and holiness of God, welcoming us into a relationship of perfect intimacy and peace. Every detail of this new creation is designed for our joy and God's glory. We rest in the assurance that the best is yet to come, and we live now in the light of that coming day.

para_meditar.texto: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

2028-07-23.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You with a heart full of gratitude for the promise of a new heaven and a new earth. Thank You for the vision of the New Jerusalem, which gives me hope and strength for every day. I praise You for Your faithfulness and Your desire to dwell with Your people in perfect harmony. I cherish the truth that You are preparing a place for me, a city of light and love where Your presence is the center of everything. Help me to live my life today in a way that reflects the holiness and beauty of that coming kingdom. May my heart be fixed on the eternal joys that await me in Your presence. I trust in Your power to make all things new and Your love to carry me home. I celebrate the victory of Your grace and the certainty of my inheritance in Christ. Fill me with a longing for Your kingdom and a peace that surpasses all understanding as I wait for the day of total restoration. I love You and I trust You with my entire future, in the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-24.versiculo: Revelation 21:6-7 KJV: "And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely. He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son."
2028-07-24.reflexion: The declaration 'It is done' brings a soothing stillness to the soul. It is the voice of the One who orchestrated the stars and who now completes the grand design of redemption. In these words, we find the ultimate assurance that God's promises are fulfilled and His victory is absolute. As the Alpha and the Omega, the Lord encompasses all of time and existence. He is the source from which everything flows and the destination toward which all things move. This sovereignty provides a safe harbor for our hearts, knowing that the One who started the work in us is faithful to complete it. The invitation to drink from the fountain of the water of life is a gesture of pure grace. This gift is available freely to every heart that recognizes its own thirst. When we come to Him with a longing soul, we find a satisfaction that sustains us through every season of life. This spiritual refreshment empowers us to persevere and overcome the challenges of this world. The promise of inheritance is the crown of this journey. To be called a son or daughter of the Most High is the highest honor imaginable. We are invited into a family bond that is eternal and unbreakable. We stand as heirs to a kingdom of peace, joy, and everlasting light, resting in the love of a Father who knows us by name and cherishes us forever.

para_meditar.texto: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

2028-07-24.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You with a heart full of gratitude for Your eternal love and Your unwavering faithfulness. I praise You as the Alpha and the Omega, the One who holds my past, my present, and my future in Your sovereign hands. I thank You for the precious gift of the water of life, which refreshes my spirit and gives me strength for each new day. I ask that You increase my thirst for Your presence, that I may seek You above all other things. Help me to walk in the victory You have already won, trusting in Your power to lead me through every trial. I cherish the wonderful truth that I am Your child, and I find my identity and my security in Your fatherly embrace. May my life reflect the light of Your kingdom and the peace of Your finished work. I trust in Your promises and I long for the day when I will see You face to face in Your glorious presence. I commit my way to You, believing that You are guiding me toward a beautiful inheritance. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-25.versiculo: Revelation 21:22-23 KJV: "And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it. And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof."
2028-07-25.reflexion: Imagine a place where every breath is a hymn of praise and every moment is spent in the direct presence of the Creator. In the vision of the New Jerusalem, we see the ultimate fulfillment of the human heart's longing for home. The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple. This means that the union between the Creator and the created is complete. We dwell within the very heart of God's holiness. Christ is our eternal sanctuary. Every corner of this city is saturated with the love and truth of the Lamb. Furthermore, the light of this place is divine. The glory of God illuminates every street and every dwelling. This light is a living radiance that brings absolute clarity and joy. It is a light that reveals the full beauty of everything it touches. We walk in a brightness that comes from the character of God, a warmth that flows from His eternal affection for His people. This is the promise of our future: a life lived in the constant, glowing presence of the One who loves us most. We look forward to a day when the light of the Lamb guides every step and the presence of the Father is our eternal dwelling place.

para_meditar.texto: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory. Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

2028-07-25.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of anticipation. We thank You for the beautiful promise of a city where Your glory is the sufficient light for all our needs. We praise You, Lord God Almighty, for being our eternal sanctuary and our forever home. We rejoice that the Lamb is the light of our future, providing a radiance that brings peace and complete understanding. Please let the warmth of Your presence fill our souls today. We ask that the light of Christ would illuminate our paths in this current season, guiding our steps toward Your truth. Fill us with the hope of the New Jerusalem, so that we may live with a heavenly perspective. May Your love be the foundation of our lives, and may Your glory be the goal of our every action. We trust in Your faithfulness to bring us home to that place of perfect communion and eternal brightness. We love You and we long for the day we see You face to face. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-26.versiculo: Revelation 22:1-2 KJV: "And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb. In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations."
2028-07-26.reflexion: The vision of the river of water of life is a beautiful reminder of the abundance and purity found in the presence of God. This river flows directly from the throne of God and of the Lamb, signifying that all true life, joy, and sustenance originate from the heart of the Creator. To imagine this water as clear as crystal is to recognize the absolute holiness and transparency of God's love. He invites us to drink from this source, offering a refreshment that satisfies the deepest longings of the human soul. Alongside this river stands the tree of life, a symbol of eternal vitality and divine provision. The twelve kinds of fruit, yielding every month, show us a God who is infinitely generous and attentive to every need. His grace is a constant stream, providing everything necessary for our wholeness. The leaves of the tree, intended for the healing of the nations, reveal God's heart for restoration. He is the Great Physician who mends every broken piece of creation. This promise of a restored world gives us a firm hope to cling to in our daily walk. We can live with the assurance that God is making all things new. His kingdom is a place of perfect peace, where the river of life sustains us and the tree of life heals us. Even now, the Holy Spirit offers us a taste of this eternal river, bringing peace to our minds and strength to our spirits as we look forward to our eternal home.

para_meditar.texto: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink. He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil. And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

2028-07-26.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude for the vision of Your eternal kingdom. We thank You for the river of life that flows from Your throne, bringing purity and peace to every soul. We praise You for the Lamb, who makes this eternal life possible for us. Lord, we ask that Your healing power, symbolized by the leaves of the tree of life, touch our lives today. Restore our hearts, mend our relationships, and bring peace to the nations of the earth. We lean on Your constant provision, trusting that Your goodness is renewed every single day. Fill us with the hope of the world to come, where every tear is wiped away and where we dwell in Your glorious presence forever. Guide our steps in the way of righteousness and let Your Spirit refresh us like the crystal-clear waters of Your kingdom. We surrender our lives to Your will, knowing that Your plans for us are good and full of hope. We love You and honor You as the Source of all life. In the name of Jesus, amen.

2028-07-27.versiculo: Revelation 22:12 KJV: "And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be."
2028-07-27.reflexion: The promise of Christ's return is a beacon of hope that illuminates the path of every believer. When the Lord declares that He comes quickly, He invites us into a state of joyful expectation and holy readiness. This divine anticipation shapes the way we interact with the world and how we prioritize our time. We find profound purpose in the knowledge that our efforts for the Kingdom of God possess eternal value. The rewards He brings are a reflection of His infinite generosity and His loving recognition of our faithfulness. Every act of kindness, every word of truth spoken in love, and every moment of quiet obedience is seen and cherished by the Master. We serve with a heart of love, knowing that our Heavenly Father is attentive to the smallest seed of faith planted in His name. This truth encourages us to persevere in doing good, even when the world seems indifferent. We are called to be faithful stewards of the gifts He has bestowed upon us, investing our energy into things that endure forever. The return of the King is the ultimate fulfillment of all our longing and the completion of the story of redemption. We look forward to the day when we will see Him face to face and experience the fullness of His presence. Our daily walk is a joyful preparation for this glorious meeting. We live in the light of His coming, allowing His grace to motivate our service to others and our devotion to Him. The promise of His reward is a gentle reminder that our labor in the Lord is always fruitful and deeply meaningful.

para_meditar.texto: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

2028-07-27.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude for the promise of Your Son's return. We thank You for the hope that sustains us through every trial and the peace that guards our minds. We ask for Your Holy Spirit to fill us with a fresh desire to serve You with all our strength and devotion. Help us to live every day with an eternal perspective, keeping our eyes fixed on the horizon where Your glory will appear. May our lives be a living sacrifice, pleasing to You in every thought and action. We pray for a heart that loves others as You have loved us, reflecting Your grace in everything we do. Grant us the endurance to remain faithful in the small things and the courage to stand firm in our faith. We long for the day when every tear is wiped away and we enter into Your eternal joy. We trust in Your perfect timing and Your sovereign will. Fill us with the joy of anticipation as we wait for the King of kings. We dedicate our works and our lives to Your honor and glory. In the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-28.versiculo: Colossians 3:13 KJV: "Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye."
2028-07-28.reflexion: The beauty of the Christian life is found in the grace we extend to one another. Colossians 3:13 calls us to a higher standard of love, one that mirrors the heart of our Savior. To forbear one another is to create a wide, welcoming space for the imperfections of others. It is a quiet patience that understands we are all works in progress. When we choose to be patient, we reflect the very patience God has shown toward us. Forgiveness is the active expression of this love. It is the decision to release the weight of a grievance and to offer peace in its place. This act of forgiveness is possible because we have already received an abundance of mercy from Christ. He saw our needs and provided a complete redemption through His sacrifice. His forgiveness is the fountain from which our own ability to forgive flows. When we look at the cross, we see the ultimate example of grace in action. We are invited to let that same grace saturate our hearts and overflow into our relationships. By choosing to forgive, we walk in the freedom that Christ purchased for us. We build communities where healing is possible and where love remains the strongest bond. Every act of kindness and every moment of patience is a testimony to the transforming power of the Gospel. We are called to be conduits of this divine love, bringing light and reconciliation to every corner of our lives.

para_meditar.texto: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink. He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

2028-07-28.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You today with a heart that desires to reflect Your wonderful love. I thank You for the immense grace You have poured into my life through Your Son, Jesus Christ. I am grateful that Your mercy is new every morning and that Your love is steadfast. Lord, I ask for the strength to be patient and forbearing with those around me. Fill my heart with a gentle spirit and a quiet mind. Give me the capacity to love others with the same depth and purity that You love me. I pray for the grace to forgive those who have caused me pain, releasing every burden into Your capable hands. Help me to see others through Your eyes of compassion and mercy. I ask that You heal every broken relationship in my life and replace tension with Your perfect peace. May my words be seasoned with grace and my actions be guided by Your Spirit. I desire to be a vessel of Your reconciliation in a world that needs Your touch. I trust in Your power to transform my heart and to make me more like Christ every day. I praise You for the freedom found in Your forgiveness. I commit my will and my emotions to Your leading, trusting that Your love is sufficient for every situation. I thank You for hearing my prayer and for the peace that surpasses all understanding. in the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-29.versiculo: Revelation 22:20-21 KJV: "He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen."
2028-07-29.reflexion: The final words of the Holy Scripture are a beautiful symphony of promise, longing, and grace. When we read the closing lines of Revelation, we encounter the heartbeat of the Christian faith: the certainty that our Savior is returning. This promise is a steady anchor for the soul, providing a divine perspective on our current journey. The declaration that He comes quickly reminds us that the story of redemption is moving toward its glorious conclusion. We find ourselves in a season of expectant waiting, where our hearts echo the cry of the early church, welcoming the return of the King. This longing is a holy desire, a pull toward the home where we truly belong. While we wait, we are enveloped in the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. This grace is a present and active power. It is the wind in our sails and the strength in our steps. It empowers us to love others, to serve with humility, and to remain steadfast in faith. The grace of Jesus is the bridge that connects our present struggles to our future glory. We live today in the light of that coming day, knowing that the One who promised is faithful. Every moment of our lives is held within His sovereign care, and every breath is a gift as we anticipate the moment we see Him face to face.

para_meditar.texto: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

2028-07-29.oracion: Heavenly Father, we come before You with hearts full of gratitude and hope. We thank You for the gift of Your Word, which concludes with the glorious promise of the return of our Lord Jesus Christ. We join our voices with the saints of all ages, crying out with joy, Even so, come, Lord Jesus. We desire Your presence above all earthly treasures. Fill us with a deep and abiding longing for Your kingdom, so that our priorities remain aligned with Your eternal purposes. We ask that Your grace would overflow in our lives today. Let this grace be our strength when we are weary and our light when the path seems dim. We trust that Your favor sustains us in every trial and guides us in every decision. Teach us to live as citizens of heaven while we walk upon this earth. May our lives be a reflection of Your love and a testimony to Your goodness. We rest in the assurance that You are faithful to complete the work You started in us. We await the day of perfect restoration with patience and peace. We love You and we adore You, in the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-30.versiculo: Colossians 3:22 KJV: "Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:"
2028-07-30.reflexion: Our daily tasks are sacred opportunities to honor the Lord. When we step into our workplaces or handle our chores at home, we carry the presence of Christ with us. True service flows from a heart that recognizes God as the ultimate Supervisor. We work with integrity because we know the Father sees every hidden act of kindness and every moment of diligence. A single-hearted devotion to God transforms a mundane job into a spiritual offering. We find joy in excellence because our primary goal is to bring glory to the Creator. Reverence for God motivates us to be honest, faithful, and hardworking even when no one is watching. This holy fear is a deep love and respect that guides our hands and our attitudes. We serve our earthly leaders with grace, knowing that our true reward comes from the King of Kings. By focusing our gaze upward, we find the strength to serve others with genuine love and a peaceful spirit. This perspective brings a profound sense of peace, as we are anchored in the steady love of our Heavenly Father. Every detail of our labor becomes a prayer, and every interaction becomes a chance to show the light of Christ to a world in need of His grace. We are called to be beacons of faithfulness in every sphere of influence, reflecting the character of the Master Servant who came to serve all.

para_meditar.texto: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily , as to the Lord, and not unto men;
With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

2028-07-30.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You today with a heart full of gratitude for the gifts and opportunities You have placed in my life. I thank You for the work You have assigned to me and for the people You have put in my path. Please grant me a spirit of excellence and a heart of sincerity. Help me to see every task, no matter how small, as an act of worship directed toward You. I ask for the grace to work with integrity and a joyful spirit, keeping my eyes fixed on Your eternal kingdom. May my actions reflect Your love and my diligence reflect Your faithfulness. Fill me with a holy reverence that inspires me to do my best in all things. I desire to please You in every thought and deed. Let my life be a testament to Your goodness and my work be a fragrance of praise to Your name. Strengthen my resolve to serve others with humility and kindness, remembering that I serve You first and foremost. I trust in Your guidance and Your provision as I navigate my daily responsibilities. in the name of Jesus, amen

2028-07-31.versiculo: Jude 1:24 KJV: "Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,"
2028-07-31.reflexion: God is the steady hand that holds us through every season of life. In Jude 1:24, we find a beautiful promise of security and hope. The strength that sustains us comes directly from Him. He possesses the power to keep us steady and secure. Every step we take is guided by His grace. We can rest in the knowledge that our salvation is a work of His divine ability. He is the one who preserves our faith and guards our hearts. This divine protection is a constant reality in the life of a believer. As we walk through the complexities of this world, we are held by a love that is stronger than any trial. God's commitment to us is absolute. He is working in us to bring us to a state of perfection. The goal of our journey is the presence of His glory. Imagine the moment we stand before Him, fully restored and faultless. This faultlessness is a gift of His mercy and the finished work of Christ. The atmosphere of that meeting is one of exceeding joy. This joy is full and complete, filling every corner of our existence. We can live today with confidence because our future is secure in His hands. His power is sufficient for every need and His faithfulness is our shield. We are safe in His grip, moving toward a glorious eternity. His grace is the anchor that keeps us firm. He is the architect of our salvation and the finisher of our faith. Every moment of our lives is an opportunity to experience His keeping power. We are cherished children of a King who ensures our arrival at our eternal home. The peace we feel today is a foretaste of the exceeding joy that awaits us. We trust in His strength, lean on His wisdom, and rejoice in His unchanging nature.

para_meditar.texto: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

2028-07-31.oracion: Heavenly Father, I come before You with a heart full of gratitude for Your unwavering strength. Thank You for being the one who is able to keep me from falling. I praise You for Your power that sustains my soul and Your love that guards my steps. I trust in Your divine ability to preserve my faith through every challenge I encounter. Thank You for the promise that You will present me faultless before Your glorious presence. I rejoice in the truth that my standing before You is based on Your grace and the perfect work of Your Son. I look forward with hope to that day of exceeding joy when I will see You face to face. Fill my heart with peace as I rely on Your keeping power today. Help me to walk in the confidence of Your love and the security of Your grip. May my life reflect Your goodness and Your faithfulness to all around me. I surrender my worries to You, knowing that You are holding me fast. I celebrate the victory that is already mine in Christ. in the name of Jesus, amen
